messages:
Alex: drift-bot flagged a config shadow in eu-west1. Prod helm release 'model-api-prod' has a values override 'traffic.weight: 30' that isn't present in staging. Canary ended up receiving more traffic than intended, SLO spike. Anyone oncall?

Drift-Bot: Automated drift detection -> namespace=model-api env=prod region=eu-west1 diff_type=values_override path=/charts/model-api/values.yaml diff=traffic.weight: 30 -> missing in staging. Severity=high. Related runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/drift-detection

Priya: oncall here. Did the canary rollout use the old helm chart or a pinned image?

Maya: saw a spike of 5xxs from the model pods in eu-west1 ~23:12 UTC, seems to line up with the traffic change. Should we scale down the canary?

Jamal: quick audit — helm history shows a 1-line manual patch applied last night by infra-ci job 'auto-rollforward'. It patched values in prod only because pipeline var was set differently in prod.

Alex: that explains the shadow. The pipeline var ENV_OVERWRITE must have been true in prod. We need to reconcile gitops state and prevent manual prod-only patches.

Priya: plan: 1) scale canary to 0 2) rollback prod release to git state 3) trigger drift sweep and GitOps reconcile. I'll take step 1.

Maya: +1. Also let's add a safety gate to infra-ci so overrides require a PR and approval.

Jamal: running quick ops commands locally:
```
kubectl -n model-api scale deploy model-api-canary --replicas=0
helm rollback model-api-prod 2
curl -sS "https://drift.internal/api/v1/sweep?release=model-api&region=eu-west1" | jq '.status'
```

Priya: scaled canary (replicas -> 0). Observability: 5xx rate dropping already. Starting helm rollback now.

Drift-Bot: Runbook action recorded: scaled canary by Priya -> OK. Queued GitOps reconcile for release=model-api region=eu-west1.

Alex: once rollback is confirmed let's run a dry-run of infra-ci and fix the pipeline var default. The manual patch came from an automated job — we must fix the source.

Jamal: opened PR to infra-ci: https://git.internal/r/infra/ci/pipelines/1234 — removes prod-only ENV_OVERWRITE default and adds a preflight check. Added a unit test to catch env drift in pipeline variables.

Priya: rollback completed, error rates back to baseline, latency normalizing. Drift sweep shows reconciling in progress. Marking follow-up actions in the PR. :white_check_mark: 

Alex: follow-up action: create a GitOps policy to block direct kubectl/patches that change Helm values in prod without a reconciled PR. Assigning to Maya.

Maya: on it — I'll draft the policy and add a preflight webhook to reject value changes unless a matching PR exists in cluster-configs repo.

Jamal: adding a unit test to drift-detector that flags 'values_override' diffs when they are unilateral (prod only). Should reduce noisy post-merge rollforwards.

Priya: I'll keep monitoring until GitOps reconcile finishes and the PR is merged. Thanks all.
